section_summary.extract_value: This section details the design and procedure of a single study. Participants provided consent, then completed three questionnaires measuring gratitude, loneliness, and social support. After the questionnaires, demographic information including gender, university location, and education level was collected. The process was anonymous and confidential, with participants able to quit at any time.
